Source bodies are staged through shared memory in tiles,\n// so each position is fetched from global memory once per block rather than once per thread.\n// Tiles and the j-loop within a tile both run in ascending j, so each body's force\n// accumulates in the same order as the sequential reference.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(Body* bodies, int n) {\n    __shared__ double sx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double sy[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double sz[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * BLOCK_SIZE + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = i < n;\n    const double xi = active ? bodies[i].pos.x : 0.0;\n    const double yi = active ? bodies[i].pos.y : 0.0;\n    const double zi = active ? bodies[i].pos.z : 0.0;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = tile + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            sx[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.x;\n            sy[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.y;\n            sz[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.z;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int count = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - tile);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            const double dx = sx[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = sy[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = sz[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void integrateKernel(Body* bodies, int n) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * BLOCK_SIZE + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    bodies[i].pos.x += bodies[i].vel.x * DT;\n    bodies[i].pos.y += bodies[i].vel.y * DT;\n    bodies[i].pos.z += bodies[i].vel.z * DT;\n}\n\n// For each body i, sums 1/dist over all j > i. +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    if (n > 0) {\n        const int numBodies = static_cast<int>(n);\n        double* d_rowSums = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_rowSums, n * sizeof(double)));\n\n        potentialRowsKernel<<<gridSize(numBodies), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, d_rowSums, numBodies);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        std::vector<double> rowSums(n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rowSums.data(), d_rowSums, n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_rowSums));\n\n        for (double rowSum : rowSums) {\n            energy -= rowSum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite,     printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps       printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of bodies: std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n\n    // Upload bodies to the device\n    const size_t bytes = bodies.size() * sizeof(Body);\n    Body* d_bodies = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_bodies, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_bodies, bodies.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Run simulation\n    auto start = computeForcesKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, numBodies);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            integrateKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_bodies, numBodies);\n bodies[i].pos.x : 0.0;\n    const double yi = active ? bodies[i].pos.y : 0.0;\n    const double zi = active ? bodies[i].pos.z : 0.0;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = tile + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            sx[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.x;\n            sy[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.y;\n            sz[threadIdx.x] = bodies[j].pos.z;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int count = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - tile);\n        for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            const double dx = sx[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = sy[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = sz[k] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void integrateKernel(Body* bodies, int n) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * BLOCK_SIZE + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    bodies[i].pos.x += bodies[i].vel.x * DT;\n    bodies[i].pos.y += bodies[i].vel.y * DT;\n    bodies[i].pos.z += bodies[i].vel.z * DT;\n}\n\n// For each body i, sums 1/dist over all j > i. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfywWB8snp2HxCRTcdWTU","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs its simulation on the GPU. `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` are the only files changed, the executable is still `nbody`, and no files were added. The build is clean with no warnings. I ran it on the RTX 3090 in this machine.\n\n**What changed**\n- **Force kernel:** one thread per body. Source positions are staged through shared memory in 256-body tiles, so each block reads global memory once per tile.\n- **Integrate kernel:** a separate kernel, which keeps the original ordering: all forces, then all position updates.\n- **Energy (`-v`):** the potential energy is also computed on the GPU, one thread per row, with the host summing the row totals.\n- **CUDA is unconditional:** there is no CPU path. The original `-h`, `-r`, `-v` behaviour and output format are kept.\n- **CMake:** the project is `LANGUAGES CXX CUDA`, and `nbody.cpp` is compiled as CUDA. Architectures are set explicitly to 75 80 86 89 90 so configuring doesn't require a GPU. The original `-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra` flags are forwarded to the host compiler, and `m` is still linked.\n\n**Correctness**\n- With FMA contraction disabled on both sides (`-fmad=false` and `-ffp-contract=off`), the output hash matches the original exactly for N = 0, 1, 2, 255, 256, 257, 777, and 1000.\n- With the default flags, results differ from the original build in the last few bits, because the compilers fuse multiply-adds differently. The original's default build gave hash `e871a7b8b5caf3a3` for N=4096; this build gives `6146…`. If you need bit-exact reproduction, add `-fmad=false` to the CUDA flags. I measured that as roughly neutral in speed, but I kept the default for performance.\n- The printed final energy can differ in the last digit at `%.6f` (e.g. `…665072.575295` vs `…665072.575294` at N=1000), because the potential sum is reduced in a different order.\n\n**Performance** (10 steps, N=16384, simulation time only)\n- CUDA: about 310–330 ms.\n- Original CPU: about 2 s per step (3977 ms for 2 steps).\n\n**Limits**\n- Single GPU only.\n- One thread per body keeps the summation order exact. For small N (e.g. the default 1024, which is 4 blocks) the GPU is under-occupied. Splitting the j-loop across threads would scale better but changes rounding, so I didn't do it.\n\n`output.txt` was already in the directory and I did not modify it."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":981,"cache_read_input_tokens":55764,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":981},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"74a66649-947c-427d-a658-7d8eeaf0fb4a","uuid":"bbd0486b-fe34-4db1-86b4-e298148313ed","timestamp":"2026-10-13T08:43:31.835Z","request_id":"req_011CfywWAhLyvz148nDHjeUZ"}
